title: Platform Troubleshooting 2
description: 04:00 Monday. Ops pages VDI on-call. Offshore users are logging multiple tickets: they cannot connect to their VM. This is AVD Personal.
scope: Out-of-hours Monday: AVD Personal. Offshore users cannot connect to their VM.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward Azure status first, then an INC before any work. If manual provision or VM spin-up fails, Microsoft SevA. Smoking gun is Microsoft stating an outage. TRM for severe estate impact; Ops can also call TRM. Recovery: live users on the bridge plus Azure workbooks for active connections. Safety-critical: do not go in as Contributor and mass-turn on VMs, or make unofficial changes, with no INC or CR.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: Azure Service Health first, INC, then a single test provision/spin-up before Microsoft SevA.
TRM on immediately because the Personal estate looks off, then Microsoft if status or spin-up says platform.
Ops call TRM while VDI confirms Azure status and that an INC is on the record.

questions.prompt: Walk through how you would handle this incident from the first call through to recovery. Write the full response in your own words.
questions.helpText: Personal VMs will not connect. Think about what you would check, and what you would not change, this early on a Monday.
questions.assessorGuidance: Score the whole write-up. Reward: Azure status first; INC before any work; Microsoft SevA if provision/spin-up fails; TRM for estate-wide impact (Ops may call them too); recovery via live users on the bridge and Azure workbooks. Do not score as demonstrated: Contributor mass power-on of Personal VMs; unofficial change with no INC or CR; skipping Microsoft when Azure status or spin-up has already failed.

scoringCriteria.label: Checks Azure status first and keeps an INC on the record before any work
Raises Microsoft SevA when manual provisioning or VM spin-up fails, and treats an MS outage as the smoking gun
Uses TRM for severe Personal-estate impact; Ops may call TRM too
Confirms recovery with live users on the bridge and Azure workbooks for active connections
Does not mass-start Personal VMs as Contributor or make unofficial changes without INC and CR
